ns2:section.sectionText: The course is offered to all facets of our campus community, undergraduates, graduates, non-music and music majors with our exploration of improvisatory music-making through a broad spectrum of compositions, artists, styles, and schools of influence,associated with such genre as the Great American Songbook of 1940s stage and radio, swing & bebop, blues, R & B, hip-hop, gospel, mainstream jazz, contemporary popular fusion influences, Euro-stream music, and new musical soundscapes.
